question: What is the correct order of periods in terms of number of elements?
solution:
The correct answer is __1 __ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Periods are the horizontal rows in the periodic table** that represent the number of electron shells in an element's atom.
 
• The **correct order of periods** in terms of the number of elements is 1 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Periodic Trends:**

 
• Periodic trends **are particular patterns found in the periodic table** that, when grouped by period and/or group, highlight different aspects of particular elements.
 
• **Dmitri Mendeleev**, a Russian chemist, **discovered them in 1863.**
 
• Atomic radius, ionization energy, electron affinity, electronegativity, valency, and metallic character are **important periodic trends.**
 
• The comparable electron structures of the elements within their respective groups or periods account for these tendencies.
